<Subject 1> is the one and only adult woman in <Picture 1>. Preserve her exact facial identity and facial proportions, long dark wavy hair, natural makeup, body proportions, white sleeveless fitted dress with a lightweight semi-sheer flowing lower skirt, gold slingback high heels, and the same overall elegant appearance. Her anatomy, clothing construction, and body ownership remain consistent throughout the video.

<Subject 2> is the outdoor courtyard environment in <Picture 1>: the warm yellow wall, white door and window frames, dark window glass, gray tiled pavement, pale green metal table, and pale green chairs. Preserve their geometry, positions, perspective, materials, and colors.

<Subject 3> is the natural daylight and photographic visual DNA of <Picture 1>: soft warm daylight, realistic skin texture, clean white fabric, muted sage-green furniture, shallow photographic depth, gentle background softness, natural contrast, and refined fashion-photography rendering.

summary:
[reference image to video + 5-second single continuous shot] Create a five-second elegant fashion portrait video beginning exactly from <Picture 1>. <Subject 1> performs only a small, natural shift of posture and weight, accompanied by subtle breathing, a gentle head adjustment, a soft blink, and naturally delayed movement of her hair and lightweight skirt caused by a mild breeze. Motion must feel physically believable, graceful, continuous, and fluid, with no sudden acceleration or exaggerated posing. The camera remains essentially locked and the original composition is preserved.

retention_analysis:
<Picture 1> ([Shot 1] first-frame and continuous composition anchor): fully_preserved - retain the exact vertical framing, camera height, perspective, subject placement, courtyard composition, furniture positions, yellow wall, door, window, pavement, lighting, and color relationships.

<Subject 1> (appears throughout [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - preserve the same woman, facial identity, hairstyle, body proportions, white dress, gold heels, anatomy, skin tone, and elegant visual character. No identity drift or body reshaping.

<Subject 2> (appears throughout [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the yellow wall, door, window, table, chairs, and pavement remain stationary and geometrically stable.

<Subject 3> (applies throughout [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - maintain the original realistic fashion-photography style, natural daylight, exposure, depth of field, skin rendering, fabric texture, and restrained warm palette.

detailed_description:
The target video is a five-second continuous fashion portrait derived directly from <Picture 1>. Overall body-motion intensity is restrained to approximately 15%–20%. The movement should look like a real person naturally holding and subtly adjusting a standing pose rather than performing a choreographed action.

[Shot 1] 00:00.000–00:01.500:
Begin exactly from <Picture 1>. <Subject 1> initially holds the reference pose. Natural breathing creates an extremely subtle rise and fall through the upper torso and shoulders. Her gaze remains calmly directed toward the camera. She performs one soft, realistic blink. A weak breeze begins to move only the loose outer strands and tips of her long hair; the roots and overall hairstyle remain stable.

00:01.500–00:03.500:
<Subject 1> slowly and naturally transfers a small amount of body weight onto her supporting leg. The movement originates from the hips and legs and propagates gently through the torso and shoulders, preserving realistic human balance. Her upper body makes a very slight relaxed adjustment while her head turns only a few degrees toward the camera and settles naturally.

Her arms remain relaxed beside her body. The hands and fingers respond with tiny secondary motion caused by the posture shift; fingers remain anatomically correct, separated naturally, and do not perform deliberate gestures.

The lightweight lower section of the white dress responds to the same mild breeze with one gentle flowing wave. Fabric motion follows gravity and inertia: the hem moves slightly outward, trails behind the body adjustment, then softly falls back. The fitted upper section of the dress remains attached correctly to the torso without stretching, sliding, or changing construction.

Her long hair shows similarly delayed secondary motion. Several outer locks sway gently away from the shoulders and return, with smooth acceleration and deceleration. Hair must behave as continuous strands rather than flickering or changing length.

00:03.500–00:05.000:
The posture adjustment gradually finishes. <Subject 1> settles into a relaxed elegant stance very close to the original pose. Her head makes a tiny natural correction and her expression remains calm and composed. Hair tips and the sheer skirt hem continue moving briefly from inertia before slowly settling.

All movement uses smooth ease-in and ease-out timing. No part of the body abruptly starts or stops. Preserve realistic balance between the planted feet, knees, hips, spine, shoulders, neck, and head.

Camera behavior:
The camera remains locked to the reference composition with only an optional extremely subtle natural cinematic micro-stability, less than 1%. No obvious camera movement. No push-in, pull-out, pan, tilt, orbit, roll, handheld shake, reframing, lens distortion, artificial parallax, focus hunting, cut, or transition.

Absolute identity and anatomy lock:
Exactly one adult woman throughout the entire video. Preserve the same face in every frame. No face morphing, facial feature drift, age change, hairstyle replacement, body reshaping, limb length change, waist deformation, chest deformation, duplicated limbs, extra arms, extra legs, extra hands, missing fingers, fused fingers, broken wrists, twisted joints, or unstable feet.

The gold slingback heels remain correctly attached to both feet. Feet stay physically grounded on the pavement with believable contact and weight. No foot sliding, floating, shoe deformation, heel disappearance, or intersection with the ground.

Environment lock:
All green chairs and the table remain rigid and stationary. The yellow wall, white door, white-framed window, pavement lines, reflections, and architectural edges remain stable. No furniture deformation, background warping, moving windows, breathing walls, geometry drift, or newly generated objects.

Rendering lock:
Maintain realistic skin texture and stable facial details. Preserve the original white fabric appearance and gold metallic shoes. No AI shimmer, texture crawling, temporal flicker, skin smoothing pulses, fabric melting, changing dress length, changing neckline, transparency fluctuation, hair regeneration, background morphing, exposure pumping, dramatic relighting, excessive bloom, CGI appearance, anime conversion, or stylization shift.

Motion priority:
natural weight shift > subtle breathing > tiny head adjustment > one realistic blink > delayed hair sway > gentle skirt movement.

The overall impression should be effortless and understated: a real fashion model naturally maintaining her pose outdoors while a light breeze softly moves her hair and skirt. Motion remains elegant, physically coherent, smooth, and continuous for the full five seconds.

overall_soundscape:
Soft outdoor courtyard ambience with a faint natural breeze and an extremely subtle rustle from the lightweight skirt and hair. No dialogue, footsteps, artificial sound effects, or prominent environmental noise.

non_diegetic_music:
No music. If a music layer is mandatory, use only a nearly inaudible soft ambient texture without vocals, percussion, strong rhythm, crescendo, or dramatic development.

subject_definitions:
<Picture 1> is the uploaded reference image and the exact visual identity and composition anchor for [Shot 1]. It is the sole reference for the woman’s facial identity, hairstyle, body proportions, white dress, gold slingback heels, courtyard environment, furniture, lighting, colors, perspective, and photographic rendering.

<Subject 1> is the one and only adult woman in <Picture 1>. Preserve exactly the same face, long dark wavy hair, body proportions, white sleeveless fitted dress with flowing lightweight lower skirt, gold slingback high heels, natural makeup, and elegant fashion-model appearance.

<Subject 2> is the existing courtyard environment: warm yellow wall, white door and window, gray tiled pavement, pale green table and chairs. All background geometry remains fixed.

summary:
[5-second fast reveal + elegant pose] Create a five-second single continuous fashion shot beginning exactly from <Picture 1>. In the opening moment, <Subject 1> performs a quick, confident fashion reveal: a brisk but natural upper-body turn toward the camera combined with a small weight shift, causing her long hair and flowing skirt to swing outward with delayed inertia. She immediately settles into an elegant pose facing the camera. After the reveal, movement becomes restrained: subtle breathing, calm eye contact, one natural blink, and slowly settling hair and skirt. The action is fast, clean, confident, physically believable, and fluid.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1]

00:00.000–00:00.300:
Begin exactly from <Picture 1>. <Subject 1> immediately initiates a quick fashion-model reveal.

Her hips remain stable and balanced over her feet while the upper torso and shoulders make a brisk, controlled rotation of approximately 8–12 degrees. Her head follows the movement naturally and slightly faster than the torso, bringing her gaze decisively toward the camera.

The action should feel like a model quickly noticing the camera and presenting herself — confident, elegant, spontaneous, not aggressive.

00:00.300–00:01.000:
The quick reveal reaches its visual peak.

Her head and shoulders finish the turn and briefly lock into direct camera engagement. The chin lifts only slightly, creating a confident fashion-pose accent.

The sudden but controlled body movement produces clear secondary motion:
her long hair swings outward behind and beside her shoulders with delayed inertia;
the lightweight lower skirt flares gently outward for a brief moment;
the dress hem trails slightly behind the body movement.

Hair and fabric movement should be noticeably faster than in a static portrait, creating a strong instant “reveal” effect, but must remain governed by realistic gravity, inertia, and air resistance.

Her arms stay naturally relaxed. Hands follow the body movement passively without deliberate gestures.

00:01.000–00:01.600:
<Subject 1> quickly settles into the elegant reference-like stance.

The torso decelerates smoothly rather than stopping abruptly. Her body weight stabilizes over the supporting leg. Her head makes a tiny final correction and she establishes calm, confident eye contact with the camera.

Hair continues past the body for a fraction of a second because of inertia, then swings softly back toward the shoulders.

The flowing skirt similarly completes one elegant residual wave before falling naturally downward.

00:01.600–00:03.500:
The dramatic reveal is complete.

<Subject 1> now holds the pose with only subtle natural breathing. Her expression remains composed, feminine, confident, and relaxed.

She performs one soft realistic blink while maintaining eye contact.

Loose hair strands continue a small residual sway in a light breeze. The sheer lower skirt gently oscillates once and gradually loses energy.

00:03.500–00:05.000:
The motion becomes extremely restrained and polished.

Her posture remains stable. A tiny natural head adjustment and subtle breathing prevent the pose from appearing frozen.

The final remaining movement in the hair tips and skirt hem slowly settles, leaving a clean fashion-editorial final pose very close to <Picture 1>.

Motion rhythm:
FAST REVEAL → CLEAN POSE LOCK → SOFT INERTIAL SETTLE → ELEGANT HOLD.

The strongest action occurs within the first 1.0 second. After 1.6 seconds, body motion becomes minimal.

Motion priority:
quick head-and-shoulder reveal > direct eye contact > delayed hair swing > flowing skirt flare > smooth pose lock > subtle breathing and blink.

Camera:
Keep the camera essentially locked to the original framing. During the first 0.8 seconds only, allow an extremely subtle cinematic micro push-in of approximately 1–2% to emphasize the reveal, then completely stabilize.

No orbit, pan, tilt, roll, large zoom, handheld shake, artificial parallax, focus hunting, cut, transition, or reframing.

Physical realism:
Movement must use continuous acceleration and deceleration. The head may lead the shoulders slightly, shoulders lead the hair, and the body leads the skirt fabric. Hair and skirt must respond with believable delayed inertia.

Do not rotate the entire body dramatically. Do not perform a full turn or spin. Feet remain planted and physically grounded. The reveal comes primarily from the head, shoulders, upper torso, gaze, and secondary hair/fabric movement.

Absolute identity lock:
Exactly one woman. Preserve the same face in every frame. No face morphing, identity drift, body reshaping, waist deformation, chest deformation, limb distortion, duplicated body parts, extra fingers, fused fingers, broken wrists, unstable legs, or changing proportions.

Foot and shoe lock:
Both feet remain naturally grounded. Preserve the exact gold slingback heels. No foot sliding, crossing errors, floating feet, disappearing heels, shoe morphing, or ground penetration.

Dress lock:
Preserve the exact white dress design, neckline, fitted upper silhouette, waist structure, skirt length, and fabric appearance. The lower skirt may flare and sway naturally but must never change construction, length, transparency, or shape permanently.

Environment lock:
All green chairs, table, yellow wall, white door, window, pavement, and architectural lines remain fixed and stable. No background warping or moving furniture.

No exaggerated hair explosion, violent skirt movement, full-body spinning, walking, stepping forward, jumping, hip swinging, dramatic arm gesture, hair touching, dress touching, blowing kiss, talking, lip movement, exaggerated smile, sudden expression change, camera rush, slow motion, frozen motion, AI shimmer, anatomy flicker, texture crawling, background deformation, or CGI conversion.

Final impression:
A stylish woman gives the camera a quick, sharp, confident reveal in the first second, with her hair and flowing white skirt catching the motion beautifully, then immediately settles into a calm high-fashion pose. The movement feels spontaneous, premium, natural, and exceptionally fluid.
